events.quote: culminating on the impugned order dated 12.03.2025.

defects_argued.quote: The impugned order dated 12.03.2025, therefore being passed after an undue and unexplained delay of nearly 8.5 years, in the considered view of this Court, is violative of Section 73(4B)(b) of the Finance Act, 1994, and is held to be arbitrary and bad in law.

outcome.quote: Writ petition stands allowed to the extent indicated above, without deliberating on the other issues and is disposed of.

review.notes: This is not a GST demand. The impugned Order-in-Original dated 12.03.2025 was passed under Section 74(2) of the Finance Act, 1994 (the service tax regime, pre-GST), confirming a demand for Service Tax, invoking the extended period of limitation under Section 73(1) of the Finance Act, 1994, with interest and penalties under Sections 75, 76, 77 and 78 of the Finance Act, 1994 (Para 1). The underlying show-cause notice is dated 05.10.2016, and the dispute concerns premiums/subscriptions under three Assam Rifles welfare schemes for periods spanning both the pre-2012 Positive List and post-2012 Negative List service tax regimes (Para 8, 12).
